title: LOG_RPG (Optimi)
description: ModPack for low-end PCs, focused on optimization
body:
Main Focus: Massive FPS boost on low-performance computers without sacrificing essential gameplay. Ideal for older PCs, weak laptops, or anyone who wants to run the game at 100+ FPS even with large worlds!

Why choose the FPS Booster Pack?
This modpack transforms vanilla Minecraft into a performance machine! With deep optimizations to the renderer, lighting, entities, and memory, you gain up to 5x more FPS compared to the base game. Tested on low-end hardware (Intel HD Graphics, 4GB RAM) – runs smoothly at 60-200 FPS on medium settings!

Revolutionary Rendering: Replaces the vanilla graphics engine with lightweight and fast alternatives.
World Optimization: Reduces lag in unnecessary chunks, entities, and blocks.
Intelligent Management: Less RAM and CPU usage, with faster loading.
Full Compatibility: Works with lightweight shaders (via Iris) and multiplayer servers.

Main Mods Included (Elite Performance Selection):
Sodium
Lithium
FerriteCore
Indium
oculus
